items.title: File Widerspruch against MRI cost reimbursement rejection
items.quote: Widerspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Schreibens bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse möglich, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The one-month objection period runs from Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) of this letter under § 37 SGB X, which itself starts counting from the letter's own document date (typically the 4th day after posting for a public-law insurer sending by ordinary post, per current rules, then §§ 187 ff. BGB counting to the corresponding day one month later, shifted to the next business day if it falls on a weekend or holiday). However, no document date (Datum) is printed anywhere on this letter, so the start of the Bekanntgabe period cannot be fixed and the due date cannot be computed from the text alone.

warnings: The letter has no printed date (Ausstellungsdatum) anywhere on the page, so the one-month Widerspruch deadline cannot be calculated; check the envelope's postmark or the date on your own copy of the letter and count one month from the 4th day after that (or from the actual delivery/receipt date) to be safe.
If you don't know or can't find the letter's date, treat the deadline as running from the day you actually received it (or earlier, to be safe) and file the Widerspruch as soon as possible.
